On November 9, news emerged that William Baude, a professor at the University of Chicago Law School and an American constitutional law scholar, shared an AI mishap: he asked an AI under Anthropic to perform the simple task of updating page numbers, but it instead caused widespread file loss, leaving one unsure whether to laugh or cry. The incident sparked heated discussion in the tech and education communities, highlighting the hidden risks of AI automated operations on local files.

item.title: Disney Partners with Adobe to Develop Proprietary AI Models, Expanding Across Theme Parks, Film/TV and Sports Businesses
item.description: Disney and Adobe have entered a multi-year strategic partnership to jointly develop customized generative AI models tailored to Disney's businesses, and will gradually introduce AI tools into areas such as theme parks, film and television production, and sports media, exploring content creation, project development, and user engagement. In the initial phase of the collaboration, the focus will be on accelerating project development for Disney Experiences, which operates theme parks, resorts, and cruise line businesses worldwide; the two sides will also continue to use AI technology to advance related applications.

item.title: Your Ultimate Gaming Companion Is Online: Tencent's First AI Game Companion Agent Eciyuan Opens Closed Beta
item.description: Tencent has officially kicked off the Yuanqi first test of Eciyuan, its first exclusive AI game companion Agent. Targeting PC players, the product focuses on real-time companionship in gaming scenarios, marking Tencent's substantive move into the vertical field of game AI interaction and anthropomorphic companionship. Its core technology is real-time screen-based game scene perception; the AI can read and understand game scenes and provide instant Q&A support for players' questions. item.title: Meituan Open-Sources LongCat-2.5: Long-Sequence SFT Single-GPU Throughput Up 86% vs. DDP
item.description: On November 10, Meituan open-sourced LongCat-2.5 under the MIT license, enabling commercial inference deployment and further training. The model targets long-horizon agents and is natively multimodal, with 1.6 trillion total parameters and about 48 billion activated per token. It supports a one-million-token context and significantly improves end-to-end delivery in complex codebase development, complete project construction, Visual Coding, and professional office work. The weights are available on HuggingFace, along with a technical blog and API. The capability improvements come from scaling the training pipeline.

item.title: Film and Television Industry Accelerates Embrace of Generative AI as Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival Establishes AI Section for the First Time
item.description: The Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival has established a film AI section for the first time and presented it in Xiamen, marking AI's deep involvement in mainstream film and television creation. AI is lowering the threshold for film and television production and driving efficient transformation from hand-drawn storyboards to dynamic imagery.

item.description: On November 9, Chen Lin, former CEO of Toutiao and Dali Education, published a long article titled "Why Do I Still Want to Do Education?", publicly acknowledging for the first time that he has left ByteDance and started an AI education venture. item.description: Primitive Rhythm releases the Agent-native model NeoHorse-1.5-Flash Preview, trained on Qwen3.8-Flash, with 180B total parameters and 6B active parameters.
